senses.gloss: (b. h.) to carry a load; to sustain; to endure.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite>, end <he>הנפש הזו סוֹבֶלֶת … והקב״ה סוֹבֵל את עולמו</he> the soul supports the body, and the Lord sustains his world; (Tanḥ. Ḥayé 3 <he>משמרת … משמר</he>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 113b:10">Pes. 113ᵇ</cite> <he>ארבעה אין … סוֹבַלְתָּן</he> there are four things which the mind (of man) cannot endure.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:11">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 4:13">Gen. IV, 13</cite>) <he>לעליונים … אתה סובל ולפשעי אין אתה סובל</he> thou bearest those on high and those below, and my trespass thou wilt not bear? Y. R. Hash. II, end, 58ᵇ (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 144:14">Ps. CXLIV, 14</cite> <he>אלופינו מסבלים</he>) <he>בשעה שהגדולים סוֹבְלִין את וכ׳</he> when the great bear the small (take care of them), there is no breach &c.; <cite ref="Psalms 144:14">ib.</cite> <he>בשעה שהקטנים סובלין וכ׳</he> when the small bear the great (respect their superiority), there is &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 888">Yalk. Ps. 888</cite>; Ruth R. introd. <he>(ושם</he>).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>סָבְלוּ מכות</he> they endured maltreatment; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:53">Y. Peah I, 16ᵇ</cite> <he>הפורק … ואיני סוֹבְלָהּ</he> he who throws off the yoke, that is, he who says, there is a law, but I will not bear it.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:17">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Ps. l. c.) <he>מְסוּבָּלִים במצות</he> laden with good deeds; <he>מס׳ בייסורים</he> laden with pains.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 963">Yalk. Deut. 963</cite> <he>מסובלים כספם וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:7">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>היו סובלים</he>) carrying their silver and their gold; a. e.
